reuse.why: Extends the single existing isNonWorkingDay check and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate; no logic is re-implemented.

duplication.why: The holiday match is defined once in isHoliday and every weekday adjustment already flows through isNonWorkingDay.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside isNonWorkingDay, the one place the tree decides non-working days.

scope.why: A three-line helper plus focused tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Small, commented and located where any future holiday format change would naturally go.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay, which now delegates to isHoliday.
